week34.0: Nwa ahụ, nke gbagọrọ agbagọ n'ihi enweghị ohere, n'ozuzu na-edebe ụkwụ ya agbagọrọ n'akụkụ obi ma na-aga n'ihu na-emega ahụ mgbe niile.
week34.3: Ọ bụ ezie na ohere belatara, mmegharị nwa ahụ na mgbanwe ọdịdị afọ gị na-anọgide na-apụta ìhè n'ozuzu.
week34.4: Ịga n'ihu na-ele mmegharị nkịtị nke nwa ahụ anya ka dị mkpa ruo mgbe a mụrụ ya.

week35.0: Nwa ahụ na-aga n'ihu na-eru arọ, nke ga-enyere ya aka ịhazi okpomọkụ ya mgbe a mụrụ ya. Ohere dị n'akpa nwa na-aghọ nke pere mpe.
week35.3: Nrụgide pelvis dị ukwuu karị nwere ike ịpụta ka nwa ahụ na-arịda nwayọ nwayọ.
week35.4: Ọ bụ ezie na ohere pere mpe, nwa ahụ kwesịrị ịga n'ihu na-emega ahụ n'usoro yiri nke izu ndị gara aga.

week36.0: N'ozuzu, ngụgụ etolitela nke ọma iji kwe ka iku ume n'onwe ya, ma nwa ahụ nwere ike ịmịkọrọ na ịgbari nri.
week36.3: Ị nwere ike mgbe ụfọdụ inwe mmetụta nsogbu iku ume, ebe akpa nwa na-ewe ohere buru ibu n'okpuru ọkpụkpụ azụ.
week36.4: A na-ewere ime dị ka nke zuru oke n'etiti izu 37 na izu 42.

week37.0: A na-ewere nwa ahụ dị ka onye tozuru etozu iji mụọ. Ọtụtụ nwa kacha nwere isi ha n'ala ugbu a.
week37.3: Mmetụta nrụgide pelvis na-abawanye bụ ihe a na-ahụkarị ka nwa ahụ na-abata n'ime pelvis.
week37.4: Site n'izu a gaa n'ihu, a na-ewere na oge erutela, a nwekwara ike ịmụ nwa n'oge ọ bụla.

week38.0: Ntutu dị nro nke kpuchiri akpụkpọ ahụ apụọla nke ukwuu, ma eriri afọ na-agbakọta meconium, nsị mbụ nke nwa ọhụrụ.
week38.3: Ịmara ihe ịrịba ama nke ibu nwa nwere ike ịba uru ka ịmụ nwa na-eru nso.
week38.4: N'ozuzu, a naghị akwado ịmụ nwa e hazịrị, mgbe a na-atụle ya n'enweghị ihe ahụike na-egosi, tupu izu 39.

week39.0: Akpụkpọ ahụ, nke dị mkpa tupu mgbe ahụ, agbawala ma na-echebe nwa ahụ nke ọma ugbu a. Mkpuchi echebe, vernix, na-eme ka ọ dị mfe ịgafe n'oge ịmụ nwa.
week39.3: Enweghị ndidi na ike ọgwụgwụ ụfọdụ bụ ihe a na-ahụkarị ka ụbọchị ịmụ nwa na-eru nso.
week39.4: Ọbara na-agagharị n'ahụ nwa ọhụrụ na-aga n'ihu na-agbanwe ozugbo a mụsịrị ya, nke nwere ike ime ka aka ma ọ bụ ụkwụ nwee agba anụnụ anụnụ obere oge.

week40.0: Nwa ahụ etolitela kpam kpam ma dị njikere ka a mụọ ya. Ụbọchị ịmụ nwa bụ atụmatụ: ọtụtụ ịmụ nwa na-eme n'ụbọchị ndị gbara ya gburugburu, tupu ma ọ bụ mgbe ya gasịrị.
week40.3: Ichere ihe ịrịba ama nke ibu nwa (mkpọchi na-adị n'usoro, mmiri ịgbawa) bụ ihe a na-ahụkarị n'oge a.
week40.4: Ịgafe ụbọchị ịmụ nwa ntakịrị ka bụ ihe a na-ahụkarị ma apụtaghị na nsogbu adịla; n'ozuzu, a na-enye nlekota anya karị.

week41.0: Nwa ahụ ka etolitere kpam kpam. Mgbe ụbọchị ịmụ nwa gafechara, n'ozuzu a na-enye nlekota anya karị iji lelee ọdịmma nwa ahụ.
week41.1: Ichere ogologo oge nwere ike iso ike ọgwụgwụ na enweghị ndidi na-abawanye.
week41.2: Ịgafe oge n'ozuzu na-eduga n'ịbawanye nlekota site n'otu ahụike.
